issues.issue: Meta description is slightly long at approximately 161 characters, which may get truncated in SERPs
issues.fix: Trim meta description to 155 characters or fewer, e.g., 'Explore the most popular cannabis strains of 2026. Compare THC levels, terpene profiles, and effects to find your perfect strain at any dispensary.'

issues.issue: No H3 subheadings used under any H2 sections, which limits keyword-rich heading hierarchy depth
issues.fix: Add H3 subheadings within longer sections such as 'What Terpenes Are Driving Cannabis Strain Popularity in 2026?' — e.g., '### Myrcene', '### Beta-Caryophyllene', '### Limonene' — to improve heading hierarchy and capture long-tail keyword variants

issues.issue: Related semantic keywords such as 'best cannabis strains 2026', 'indica vs sativa 2026', and 'top dispensary strains' are underused in headings and body copy
issues.fix: Naturally incorporate related terms in at least 2-3 subheadings and early paragraphs to improve topical authority and semantic coverage

issues.issue: Strain THC ranges are presented as factual data but are generalized estimates — real-world COA results vary significantly by batch, grower, and market
issues.fix: Add a brief disclaimer noting that THC percentages are approximate ranges based on commonly reported test results and may vary by product and producer

issues.issue: The entourage effect is described as an emerging concept but is cited alongside consumer-facing terpene effect claims (e.g., limonene 'mood-brightening') that are not fully established in clinical literature
issues.fix: Add a qualifier when stating terpene consumer effects — e.g., 'commonly reported by consumers' or 'associated with in survey data' — to distinguish anecdotal associations from peer-reviewed findings

issues.issue: Jealousy is described as a cross of 'Sherbert Bx1 × Gelato 41' but some breeder documentation lists the cross differently depending on the phenotype; the parentage should be attributed to a specific breeder
issues.fix: Attribute Jealousy genetics to Seed Junky Genetics and note that documented lineage may vary by phenotype expression to avoid factual disputes

issues.issue: Source 3 (University of Mississippi) and Source 4 (Cornell University) link only to institutional homepages rather than to specific research departments, publications, or pages relevant to cannabis terpenes and genetics
issues.fix: Update URLs to link to the most relevant subdirectory or publication page available, such as the UM RIPS cannabis research page or Cornell CALS plant breeding pages, to improve credibility and reduce the appearance of generic institutional padding

issues.issue: Only 6 citation instances are distributed across a relatively long article; sections like 'Blue Dream — The Enduring All-Rounder' and 'Gelato #33, Gary Payton, and Wedding Cake' have no inline citations
issues.fix: Add at least 2-3 additional inline citations to uncited strain sections and the conclusion to bring total citation count to the recommended 8-12 range and ensure even citation distribution throughout the article

issues.issue: The 'How to Choose the Right Strain' section is practical but does not address consumption method (flower vs. concentrate vs. edible) which significantly affects how any strain's effects are experienced
issues.fix: Add a brief note clarifying that all strain recommendations assume flower consumption and that concentrate or edible formats will produce different onset times, potency levels, and effect durations

issues.issue: The image alt text ('Most popular cannabis strains 2026 displayed in organized collection') is descriptive but generic and misses an opportunity to include the target keyword naturally
issues.fix: Update alt text to something more specific and keyword-inclusive, such as 'Most popular cannabis strains of 2026 including Blue Dream, Runtz, and Jealousy displayed at a dispensary'
